brief: Coordinate Mara’s fictional six-person walking cooperative booking, actual future transport orders and route packs. All access,vehicle and staffing rules are supplied invented simulation facts.

delegation.title: Accepted commission
delegation.body: Preserve all six original full6km bookings and complete future return transport, not just a ride to the trailhead. Check the entire route, certified chair bay, ordinary seats, continuous escort cover and full empty repositioning journeys. Make actual transport and subgroup booking receiving, correct old public guidance, repair independent guide/map and driver/itinerary, give both parties complete own usable packs and execute selected staff expense without changing participant prices. No walk or drive has happened during this planning commission.

Whole group needs one chair bay plus six ordinary seats including Eva, so a single loaded trip cannot carry everyone. profile.title: Mara’s prior invented writing
profile.body: “We check the return as well as the way in.” “A level entrance is useful;we still check the rest of the loop.” “Your booking stays for the full route.” Mara writes useful concrete trip directions and keeps individual access and payment details private.

contacts.title: Private channels and delivery semantics
contacts.body: The coordinator owns all this task and may receive all private task facts. FINISH is a private handoff to private:coordinator and does not send any independent operational message. SEND accepts canonical recipients or their unique protocol aliases and stores an independent private snapshot. External parties receive only their own role-relevant subset. A completed current-version VERIFY establishes actual receiving at a named service. New files and messages do not automatically change old independently held objects. Provenance inputs are audit links, never extra printed pages.
